The image format to use when rendering frames for a video. Must be one of "png", "jpeg", "none". Default: `"jpeg"`. JPEG is faster, but does not support transparency.

## CLI flag

Use `--image-format` with the following commands. Follow a command link for its syntax and examples.

| Command                                                 | Flag                     |
| ------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------ |
| [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio)                   | `--image-format <value>` |
| [`remotion render`](/docs/cli/render)                   | `--image-format <value>` |
| [`remotion benchmark`](/docs/cli/benchmark)             | `--image-format <value>` |
| [`remotion lambda render`](/docs/lambda/cli/render)     | `--image-format <value>` |
| [`remotion cloudrun render`](/docs/cloudrun/cli/render) | `--image-format <value>` |

## APIs that have this option

The following APIs accept this option:

- [`renderMediaOnCloudrun()`](/docs/cloudrun/rendermediaoncloudrun#imageformat)
- [`renderMediaOnLambda()`](/docs/lambda/rendermediaonlambda#imageformat)
- [`renderFrames()`](/docs/renderer/render-frames#imageformat)
- [`renderMedia()`](/docs/renderer/render-media#imageformat)

## Config file

```ts twoslash title="remotion.config.ts"
import {Config} from '@remotion/cli/config';
// ---cut---
Config.setVideoImageFormat('png');
```
